items.title: Meta spend 2026-10-21: $48.96, 2 leads, CPL $24.48
items.summary: Flooring Problems Campaign was the only campaign that spent ($48.96 of its $50 daily budget), producing 2 leads on 1,007 impressions and 21 clicks. CPL is in line with the 7-day baseline of $25.13.
